decisions.reason: The current About-page copy leaves code-free ticket issuance uncertain, while the source establishes one commission and one ticket per non-promotional mint and identifies weighted-draw allocation as applicable.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: The number of commissions and tickets should each equal the number of mints, excluding promotional mints. However, those distributed by weighted draw do not seem to be registering.

value_updates.no_referral_rewards_copy: Explain that each non-promotional code-free mint creates one $10 commission and one prize ticket, with both assigned by weighted draw among eligible NFT owners; promotional mints are excluded.

decisions.reason: The source changes commission and ticket issuance coverage and counts, but it does not change the $30 mint price or the existing $25 accepted-referral and $18 missing-or-rejected-referral allocation amounts.
